thread:
elaine (AE): Quick sync: Medicalia wants a POC next week. Req's: SSO via SAML (IdP + SP flows), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk), group->role mapping, and tenant-level partitioning by subdomain. They also attached a security questionnaire. Can we run a pre-call to cover blockers?

raj (SE): I can do a 30m pre-call. Questions up front: do they need assertion encryption or just signing? Also ask if they need persistent NameID or email-based.

nina (Security): Important: their compliance team requires customer-managed KMS for encryption keys (bring-your-own key), audit logs for auth and provisioning events retained 18 months, SCIM audit trail for deltas, and SCIM retry/backoff semantics documented. We also need formal domain proof (DNS TXT) for subdomain tenancy.

elaine (AE): They did call out BYOK as a must-have. Pricing team will need to know if that forces Private/Dedicated or supported on Hosted with extra controls.

tom (Solutions): For mapping, recommend sending them this example to feed into Okta/Azure AD config. It maps groups to our RBAC roles and sets tenant claim: ```json
{
  "scim": {
    "userName": "userName",
    "displayName": "name.formatted",
    "groups": "groups",
    "tenantClaim": "urn:redwood:tenant"
  }
}
```

raj (SE): SAML metadata sample to share with their IdP admin: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://medicalia.redwood.example/sp\">
  <SPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol\">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://medicalia.redwood.example/saml/acs\"/>
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

nina (Security): Also request: list of signing cert thumbprints, support for clock skew tolerance config, and docs for SCIM rate-limits. If Hosted demo uses temporary rate limit increases, that must be in writing in the POC plan.

elaine (AE): Scheduling: propose pre-call tomorrow 11am PT, then POC kickoff Tue. Can everyone make 11am?

raj (SE): 11am works. I'll prep a troubleshooting checklist (assertion debug tips, how to inspect SAML response, common errors).

tom (Solutions): Add fallback plan for the demo: if SAML integration hits delays we can use token-based login for POC UX while provisioning is validated. Note that fallback won't satisfy their compliance team though.

nina (Security): For contract/legal: if they insist on BYOK + HSM we may need Private deployment. I'll outline which questionnaire answers will force that requirement.

provisioning-bot: Note: demo-provisioner cluster scale-up requested by raj at 2024-04-08T09:15Z. Temp limits extend 96h.

elaine (AE): Action items: 1) @raj prepare demo plan and SAML/Saml troubleshooting doc 2) @tom send SCIM mapping + sample Okta JSON to customer 3) @nina mark questionnaire items that force Private deployment 4) I'll prepare provisional pricing note: Hosted+Enterprise supports SCIM & group->role mapping; BYOK/HSM, extended retention, and guaranteed bulk provisioning windows are quoted as Dedicated/Private add-ons.

raj (SE): I'll include a short how-to for verifying DNS TXT tenant binding (example): ```bash
# verify DNS TXT for tenant subdomain
dig +short TXT tenant.medicalia.com
# expect: \"redwood-tenant=medicalia-12345\"
```

elaine (AE): Great. I'll send calendar invites and attach the questionnaire. Please upload your draft responses to the thread after the pre-call so I can forward to the customer. :white_check_mark:
